: General Manager - Platform Engineering
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a highly experienced and capable Senior System & Network Administrator with 7+ years of hands-on experience in managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network security, server administration, and IT facility management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and reliability of the organization's IT infrastructure while minimizing operational downtime.
  
  
As a key member of the IT Infrastructure & Facility Management function, the candidate will oversee enterprise networks, Windows and Linux servers, security systems, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, IT procurement, asset management, and end-user support. The role also involves managing vendor relationships, software licenses, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and infrastructure performance reporting.
  
  
Experience in a manufacturing environment will be an added advantage, particularly in supporting plant operations, business-critical systems, and uninterrupted IT services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise networks, including Cisco routers, switches, VLANs, and network segmentation.
* Manage firewalls, UTM security features, NAT/PAT configurations, and secure VPN connectivity for site-to-site and remote access.
* Administer endpoint security solutions, including Sequrite Endpoint Protection, and maintain awareness of EDR, XDR, and MDR security technologies.
* Manage Windows Server, Linux systems, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), DNS, DHCP, proxy servers, and virtualization infrastructure.
* Plan and execute server upgrades, firmware updates, BIOS updates, operating system patching, and end-of-life hardware replacements.
* Maintain reliable backup and recovery processes, periodically verify backup integrity, and support infrastructure continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Manage Office 365 / Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace environments, including user accounts, access controls, and identity management.
* Monitor network and server performance using enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios, proactively identifying and resolving infrastructure issues.
* Analyze system logs, network traffic, and security events to identify faults, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Support the installation, configuration, and maintenance of MSSQL and MySQL databases, including basic queries, database maintenance, and user access management.
* Manage IT assets, endpoint compliance, hardware and software inventory, device security policies, and asset lifecycle tracking.
* Oversee IT facility infrastructure, including IP CCTV surveillance, biometric attendance systems, and associated physical security technologies.
* Plan IT budgets, evaluate hardware and software requirements, assess vendors, negotiate commercial terms, and manage procurement activities.
* Take ownership of annual renewals for AMCs, software licenses, application subscriptions, and infrastructure support contracts.
* Manage the IT helpdesk and ticketing workflows, ensuring timely resolution of user issues in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain updated network diagrams, infrastructure documentation, technical inventories, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports covering network performance, server downtime, helpdesk tickets, user complaints, security incidents, and hardware ageing.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable IT services and continuous infrastructure improvement.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches, firewall administration, UTM, NAT/PAT, and VPN configurations.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Linux administration.
* Experience with virtualization technologies, server hardware, storage, system patching, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of endpoint protection solutions, security policies, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience in implementing and monitoring backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 / Office 365 or Google Workspace administration and identity management.
* Working knowledge of network and infrastructure monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios.
* Basic administration of MSSQL and MySQL databases, including queries, maintenance, and access controls.
* Experience in IT asset management, hardware/software procurement, vendor coordination, AMC management, and license renewals.
* Knowledge of helpdesk ticketing systems, SLA management, IT documentation, and MIS reporting.
* Familiarity with IP CCTV, biometric access or attendance systems, and related IT facility infrastructure.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent ownership and accountability for infrastructure availability and service continuity.
* Ability to prioritize incidents and resolve issues under time-sensitive conditions.
* Good communication and coordination skills with users, vendors, and management.
* Strong planning, documentation, reporting, and IT asset management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple infrastructure activities independently and lead technical service delivery.
* Cost-conscious approach to procurement, vendor management, and infrastructure optimization.

**Must have**

* Experience in IT infrastructure management within a manufacturing or plant-based environment.
* Exposure to production-critical applications, ERP systems, and business operations.
* Experience with remote deployment and automation of firmware, BIOS, and operating system updates.
* Experience in IT budget planning, commercial negotiations, vendor evaluation, and annual contract management.

**Good To have**

* Experience with high-availability infrastructure, production clustering, and server modernization.
* Familiarity with EDR, XDR, MDR, and advanced threat detection and response practices.
* Knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) practices, incident management, change management, and SLA governance.
* Exposure to infrastructure security audits, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery drills

~70 km from Delhi, ~40 km from Ghaziabad, 55 km from Noida
  
  
**Connectivity**

* Railways ( 50-60 Min), and
* Metro/Rapid connectivity ( 30-40 Min) from Delhi and Noida.

**Cost Advantage:**
Lower cost of living than Delhi /Noida, making it attractive for professionals

title: Automotive Systems and Applications Engineer
description:
Business Unit Description
  
  
NXP’s Automotive Processing business line provides the processing power and system enablement needed to accelerate the
**next generation of automotive innovation**
, including vehicle networking, wireless connectivity, body and chassis, powertrain, safety, gateway, zone control, advanced driver assistance systems and central-compute applications. The business line includes flagship automotive processor platforms such as S32G, S32Z/E, S32N, and other next-generation real-time and applications processing devices that enable scalable vehicle architectures for
**software-defined vehicles (SDVs)**
and connected automotive platforms.
  
  
**Vehicle architectures**
are rapidly evolving from distributed ECU-based systems to zonal, domain and central-compute architectures, where
**software**
,
**high-speed networking**
,
**real-time processing**
,
**security**
,
**safety**
and
**AI-driven workloads**
are becoming key differentiators.
**Edge AI**
is bringing a major revolution to automotive innovation by enabling intelligent and safe decision-making closer to the vehicle.
  
  
**Job Summary**

* This position will be a part of AP Business Line working on above mentioned products directly associating with this transformation by combining heterogeneous compute, real-time processing, networking, accelerator integration and software enablement for next-generation automotive platforms.
* Solve customer system design issues throughout all stages of the customer product development cycle (conception through production). Provide responsive and thorough hardware and software technical support to enable successful launch and production of customer systems.
* Create and own the development of evaluation and demonstration HW and SW solutions that showcase NXP automotive devices capabilities and value proposition.
* Create and own solution development and proof-of-concept activities for automotive processor platforms, including reference boards, diagnostics software, software package enablement, and silicon bring-up.
* Contribute to NPI development, create technical documentation and training material to enable customers
* Support marketing efforts to position NXP as a thought leader in automotive applications.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Promote NXP design-win activities by enabling customer transition from reference designs to production applications.
* Create evaluation and demonstration hardware and software solutions to showcase the value, performance and innovation of NXP automotive processors.
* Support customer system design, debug and integration activities across the complete customer development cycle, including concept, evaluation, bring-up, validation, production readiness and post-launch support.
* Develop and demonstrate innovative embedded automotive solutions across vehicle networking, gateway, vehicle dynamics, safety, real-time processing, central-compute, zonal architecture(s) and AI-enabled edge workloads.
* Contribute to NPI activities through application readiness, reference board support, diagnostics software, software package validation, customer enablement, collateral creation and training material.
* Provide technical guidance to field applications engineers, sales engineers, marketing teams and customers on processor features, system architecture, software enablement, debug methodology and platform integration.
* Work closely with marketing, product management, product definition, test engineering, hardware development and software development teams to enable successful launch and adoption of new automotive processors.
* Provide customer input, competitive intelligence and technical feedback to internal teams to optimize processor platforms, software enablement, collateral, tools and customer experience.
* Create technical documentation, application notes, training material, demos, quick-start guidance, debug notes and customer-facing enablement collateral.

Cross-Functional Aspects
  
  

* Collaborate with customers, FAEs, sales, marketing, systems engineering, software engineering, hardware design, product definition, validation and test teams to drive customer success and product adoption.
* Act as the technical voice of the customer inside NXP, helping internal teams understand customer requirements, issue trends, product gaps, competitive positioning and solution opportunities.
* Support technical queries from field applications engineers, sales engineers and marketing teams with clear, accurate and timely responses.
* Contribute to solution roadmap discussions by aligning device capabilities, customer use cases, software readiness, demo priorities, collateral needs and market trends.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree(s) in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
* 8-12 years of relevant experience in embedded systems, software development, automotive processors and system applications, systems engineering, HW/SW development
* Strong hands-on development experience with MCU/MPU architecture(s), Arm-based is an advantage.
* Strong hands-on experience with compilers, emulators, RTOS, bare-metal software, system initialization and embedded debug techniques.
* Strong hands-on with Operating System(s), porting BSPs, boot flows, drivers and system-level debugging. Development experience with Linux, QNX, FreeRTOS, and Hypervisors is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of HW and SW (system) debugging using debug tools like T32, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, digital voltmeters, LabVIEW or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of automotive communication interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet, PCIe protocols and associated software is an advantage.
* Experience interacting directly with customers and solving complex technical issues throughout all stages of customer development cycles.
* Knowledge of AI principles, machine learning fundamentals, model optimization concepts and edge AI deployment workflows is desirable. Prior experience with edge AI accelerators, AI/ML runtime environments, model deployment on embedded targets, and performance or memory optimization for AI workloads will be an advantage.
* Must have very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability and desire to travel domestically and internationally as required.

 Cisco ACI and Data Center Networking

 Enterprise Network Operations

* Troubleshoot routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP, based on the network design.

 Firewall and Network Security

 Monitoring and Documentation

* Review alerts, logs, events, health scores, and performance trends and take appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain network diagrams, configuration standards, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Prepare shift handovers, incident reports, post\-incident reviews, and operational documentation.

* 3\-7 years of experience in network engineering, network operations, data\-center networking, or infrastructure support.
* At least 2 years of hands\-on experience supporting Cisco ACI and APIC.
* Strong understanding of Cisco ACI architecture and its policy\-driven operating model.
* Hands\-on experience with tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, contracts, application profiles, L2Out, and L3Out.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4, subnetting, VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, and inter\-VLAN routing.
